replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. Detection state is per connection, so replicas > 1 are safe; with persistence each replica fetches its own copy of the models (per-ordinal PVC).

modelFetch.description: Init container that downloads custom wake word models before the server starts. Runs only when `models` is non-empty.

enabled.description: Whether to run the model-fetch init container. Set to false when the models volume is provisioned another way (e.g. pre-populated PVC).

resources.description: Kubernetes ResourceRequirements for the init container.

models.description: Custom wake word models (.tflite) to download into modelsDir. Each entry requires `name` and one of `path` (inside modelsCollection, the community wake word collection) or `url` (direct .tflite URL). Leave empty to serve only built-in models.

name.description: Model name: becomes <name>.tflite on disk and the wake word name clients see (an _vX.Y suffix is stripped by the server).

path.description: Path inside the community collection (modelsCollection), e.g. en/glados/glados.tflite. Spaces are percent-encoded automatically. Ignored when `url` is set.

url.description: Direct URL to a .tflite file (e.g. a dscripka/openWakeWord release asset). Wins over `path` when both are set.

sha256.description: Optional expected SHA-256 of the downloaded file (verified after download).

optional.description: Continue when this model fails to download instead of blocking the pod start.

modelsCollection.description: Base URL for models[].path entries: the community wake word collection (fwartner/home-assistant-wakewords-collection). Override to point at a fork or mirror.

modelsDir.description: Directory inside the pod where custom models are written and loaded from (--custom-model-dir).

threshold.description: Wake word threshold 0.0-1.0 (higher = fewer false activations).

env.description: Environment variables for the server container.

extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables as a list of {name, value} objects.

modelsStorage.description: Models storage when persistence is off (ephemeral emptyDir).

size.description: emptyDir sizeLimit for the models directory (soft cap).

persistence.description: Persistent storage for custom models via StatefulSet volumeClaimTemplate, so models are fetched once and survive restarts.

probes.description: tcpSocket probes on the Wyoming port (the Wyoming protocol has no HTTP health endpoint).

resources.description: Kubernetes ResourceRequirements for the server container.

allowModelDownloads.description: Generate egress rules allowing the model-fetch init container to reach HTTPS (plus DNS). Disable only if models are pre-provisioned another way.

ingress.description: Standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy ingress rules (flavor kubernetes).

egress.description: Extra standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy egress rules appended after the auto-generated ones (flavor kubernetes).
Extra Cilium egress rules appended after the auto-generated ones (flavor cilium).
